_comment: Tool schemas for the Doza Assist local MCP server (mcp/server.py). Read-mostly: no delete, no edit of editor-owned clips, no My Style access. Only projects whose 'AI assistant access' is ON (project page gear menu) are visible, and only on a licensed copy. The server and every tool carry the Doza Assist app icon (MCP 'icons', a 128 px PNG data URI) so clients that show connector icons display the logo. Every tool carries a human title and MCP annotations (readOnlyHint/destructiveHint/idempotentHint/openWorldHint) so clients can auto-approve the read-only ones; only create_my_select and export_my_stringout write (a new select, a new stringout file), and nothing is destructive.

tools.name: list_my_projects
tools.description: [This Mac] List the Doza Assist projects an AI assistant may read (the editor turned on 'AI assistant access' for them). Returns id, name, duration in seconds, speaker count and select count.
tools.title: List My Doza Projects

tools.name: get_my_transcript
tools.description: [This Mac] Timecoded transcript segments with speaker for one project. Optional speaker filter and start/end window in seconds.
tools.title: Read a Transcript

speaker.description: Only segments by this speaker (display name)

tools.name: search_my_projects
tools.description: [This Mac] Search a project's transcript locally (no cloud model). Returns timecoded hits with speaker and about 10 seconds of context on each side.
tools.title: Search a Transcript

tools.name: get_my_selects
tools.description: [This Mac] Selects (marked ranges) in the project's Clip Library with author, range and comment. Optional author filter ('Editor' or 'AI assistant').
tools.title: Read Selects

tools.name: create_my_select
tools.description: [This Mac] Create a select attributed to 'AI assistant' (shown in the Clip Library). Never modifies existing clips.
tools.title: Create a Select

tools.name: export_my_stringout
tools.description: [This Mac] Build a selects stringout (one timeline of the project's selects, pre-cut, for the editor's chosen NLE) and return its file path. 'include' picks whose selects: all (default), editor, or ai.
tools.title: Export a Selects Stringout
